meta.title: FIFA World Cup 2026 - archived results
meta.source: ESPN public scoreboard API (site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/soccer/fifa.world/scoreboard?dates=YYYYMMDD), one request per day, Jun 11 - Jul 19 2026
meta.keys: Object keys are the page's own match keys: 'home|away' for group matches, 'homeSlot|awaySlot' (e.g. 'W SF1|W SF2') for knockouts. seq = chronological order by ESPN kickoff; num = official knockout match number (73-104) taken from the page's slot names.
meta.orientation: Group matches keep the page's home/away order (hs/as follow it); knockout home/away follow ESPN's homeAway. pens is the shoot-out score and is only set when result is 'pens'; hs/as exclude the shoot-out.
meta.events: Goals (incl. penalties and own goals; own goals are listed on the side credited with the goal) and cards from ESPN's scoreboard 'details'. Shoot-out kicks and substitutions are not archived.
